label: Mk1 core drill
note: Doc 20 section 4.1's drill: one cycle is half an hour on the block under the rig and draws 2,000 cu from the battery; rock_factor 2 is the bit's rating, which the mining cut (SM.7) reads against the ground. A cycle lifts whole tonnes by the block's richness, 1 lean, 2 fair, 3 rich, into the hopper; a barren block lifts nothing. It works only the cell it stands on, so it has no radius; every radius a tool names is per axis, a square.
